mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC momentum is negative and unbroken across all four weekly means, falling from -21.7 to -24.9. This serial decline persists into the next four weeks because no observable series shows a level shift large enough to reverse it, so the next 28-day mean prints below the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: The next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC equals or exceeds -22.875, the mean of the last four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing below zero (from 3.3 to -0.3 to -0.1) marks the loss of discretionary station traffic. Because transit trips and retail trips are complements inside the same trip chains, RETAIL_REC stays below its recent level for the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean below 0.0 in two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from 4.4 to -0.1 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean exceeds -22.875 while TRANSIT remains below 0.0 for the whole horizon.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of WORKPLACES collapsing from -3.7 to -10.3 while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated near +5.5 indicates a renewed stay-at-home regime. With commuters removed from activity centres, weekday retail footfall falls further over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 3 points week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL is above +4
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped 6.6 points between t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is above -22.875 despite WORKPLACES remaining below -7 and RESIDENTIAL above +4.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS declining monotonically from -20.7 to -23.0 tracks the seasonal loss of outdoor daylight activity. Households substituting indoor for outdoor leisure also cut discretionary retail trips, dragging RETAIL_REC lower over a four-week horizon.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS continues to print new four-week lows.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM decaying from 8.6 toward 2.3 shows the stock-up channel closing. As provisioning trips normalise back to baseline, the cross-visit lift such trips give to adjacent retail disappears, pulling RETAIL_REC down over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is at or above -22.875 while GROCERY_PHARM keeps falling toward 0.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL rolling over from 5.9 to 5.0 is the first sign that households are leaving home again. One point of released residential time converts into out-of-home errands within one week, lifting RETAIL_REC above its recent mean.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls at least 0.5 points week-on-week while TRANSIT is flat or rising
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL eased from 5.9 to 5.0 while TRANSIT ticked from -0.3 to -0.1
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL continuing to decline.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT stabilising at the zero line after a four-week slide (3.3, -0.3, -0.1) is a floor signal. When station traffic stops falling, retail footfall follows within four weeks as trip chains are rebuilt under unchanged restrictions.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT week-on-week change is zero or positive in two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stopped falling between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean stays below -22.875 even though TRANSIT holds above -0.5 for four consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT below zero combined with WORKPLACES below -7 defines a low-contact regime. When both series are simultaneously depressed, retail recovery is capped and RETAIL_REC prints a lower 28-day mean within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below 0 and WORKPLACES below -5 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both worsened in the final two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the next seven days while TRANSIT is below 0 and WORKPLACES below -5.
